opening_summary: Darryl Anka (speaking for Bashar's teachings) discusses extraterrestrial contact history and the distinction between indigenous cultures' ongoing ET awareness versus Western civilization's impending recognition. He explains that ETs have been present for thousands of years but Western culture is only now awakening to this reality. Indigenous peoples have maintained continuous contact and understanding of star beings. Open contact is framed as the final culture on Earth recognizing what others already know. He describes cycles of ET involvement—periods of hands-off observation allowing human evolution, followed by renewed contact and guidance. The current era marks a transition toward open revelation and collaboration.
